verdict.line: You lose if you let Nasus stack Q uncontested into a 20-minute all-in; you win if you poke him off the wave and deny farm before level 9.

brief.thesis: Nasus's only damage tool, Q (Siphoning Strike), has 255 range and an 8/7/6/5/4s cooldown that only gets scary once he's slain enough minions to stack it — your Q (Blinding Dart) and E (Toxic Shot) both reach to 680, so every early trade should happen entirely outside his Q range. The matchup flips once those stacks pile up: his Soul Eater lifesteal and ballooning Q damage turn a close lane into a losing late fight, win rate landing at 49.4% over 1641 games because most Teemos win the first ten minutes and lose the next twenty.

theirWindow.what: Wither (15/14/13/12/11s cooldown, 700 range) is his only way to stick to a kiting target — if it connects, disengage immediately using your W (Move Quick) passive speed rather than trading autos, since his Q threat scales directly with stacks you don't want to feed him.

yourWindow.what: With no slow available Nasus cannot close 680 range — walk up, land E (Toxic Shot) autos and a Blinding Dart on any Q attempt, then kite back before his next Wither comes off cooldown.

playing.title: Poke from outside 255 range
playing.detail: Nasus's Q (Siphoning Strike) can't reach past 255 units — stand at 680 and chip with E (Toxic Shot) autos and Q (Blinding Dart) whenever he walks up for a minion.

playing.title: Count his Q stacks, not just his level
playing.detail: A level 9 Nasus with 40 stacks hits far harder than one with 15 — adjust how much damage you respect per trade based on stacks, not just levels.

playing.title: Blind any all-in attempt
playing.detail: Blinding Dart's 8s cooldown means you can deny one Q from landing on nearly every engage he starts.

playing.title: Punish the Wither cooldown window
playing.detail: Once his W (Wither, 15-11s cooldown) is down, he has zero tools to stick to you — this is when you push trades hardest.

playing.title: Avoid standing in Spirit Fire
playing.detail: His E (Spirit Fire, 12s cooldown, 650 range) strips armor on anyone standing in it — step out immediately rather than trading through the zone.

playing.title: Respect his R after level 6
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands (120s cooldown) gives him bonus health and max-health drain for its duration — don't extend fights once he activates it.

playing.title: Use R for zone control, not just lane
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown but is limited by your mushroom charges — seed river/jungle entrances to deny his jungler and deny vision rather than spamming them in lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures above are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the trade-pattern and timing advice is my own read of the kit interactions, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Wither (W) reduces attack speed and movement speed! Use Blinding Dart [Q] if Nasus uses Wither (W) to retreat, and close in once it is on cooldown!
